name: email-reply
description: Reply to an existing email thread. By default, replies to all participants (reply-all). Pass cc as empty string to reply to sender only, or as a comma-separated list to explicitly set recipients. Provide the Nylas message ID to reply to and the reply body.

inputs.cc: string? (comma-separated — omit for reply-all default, empty string to reply to sender only)
inputs.attachments: object[]? (file attachments — array of {file_url: string, filename: string, content_type: string}. file_url must be a file:// URL from email-download-attachment or similar. Max 10 attachments, 20 MB total.)
inputs.context_bridge: string? (JSON — optional context bridge registration: {agent_id, expected_reply?, delegation_hint?, metadata?, expires_in_hours?})
